GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 4.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, carried wider on turn then hooked Six Wide (widest) Straightening Up and lost a length while moving from 5th to 4th in Straight # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped and carried wider rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 6 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # mostly Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 200m was eased whilst momentarily tightened for room whilst commencing to weaken.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1.5 Lengths and Settled Down worse than midfield, trailed 5.5 Lengths on fence turning, took cutaway and picked up a length in straight. [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # slowly away
Jumped okay then hampered & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked widest Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping and hampered shortly after.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly then Eased & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover , little change to 5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, hooked widest Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped shortly after the start. Raced three wide, with cover, in the early and middle stages.  Steadied outwards after improving onto heels near the 600m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & 2nd Two Wide trailing a half length, held together much same to turn trailing 0.75 Lengths , Lost Ground in Straight # no excuses

Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths on fence, hurdled section of track at 700m, dropped back 1.5 lengths while hurdling, Drifted Back to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, improved only marginally in straight. [Stewards: Passing 700m, hurdled a section of the track, causing rider to become unbalanced.] # had trouble midrace
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 700m, hurdled a section of the track, causing the rider to become unbalanced, shifted out and carried a runner wider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Outside Leader Beaten off Straightened Up Couldn'T Go On basic Effort rider-horse wasnt suited to heavy track with big weight..vet-clear # basic Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported not suited by 60kg weight impost on heavy 9. Stable advised will be spelled.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th Inside 2 Lengths Same Straightened Up raced Tight but didn't finish off when Clear ..vet-clear # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider John Allen reported the mare travelled well in the early and middle stages, however, failed to respond to his riding over the concluding stages. A post-race veterinary examination did not identify any significant abnormal findings.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Went Forward Settled Down Outside Lead Straightened Up =lead good kick and won softly # controlled race
